question: What is the average order value (sum of price times quantity per order) for completed orders placed in 2024? Round to 2 decimal places. Return a single column named avg_order_value.

gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM (  SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS order_total   FROM orders o   JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id   JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id   WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date LIKE '2024-%'   GROUP BY o.id)
